reason: The cited evidence (E1) discusses refractory high-entropy alloys as thermal barrier interlayers for W and CuCrZr, not Ni interlayers for W-Cu wetting. It provides no support for the key premises about Ni improving wetting, reducing voids, or enhancing durability under irradiation.
premises: Ni interlayer improves wetting and bonding between W and Cu
Ni interlayer reduces void formation and phase separation in W-Cu composites
Ni interlayer preserves mechanical durability under irradiation
